links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of clinicians with collaborative AI workflows versus traditional resources
links.effect: Clinicians using collaborative workflows achieved 85% (AI-first) and 82% (AI-second) accuracy versus 75% with traditional resources (p < 0.0004 and p < 0.00001); no significant difference from AI-alone at 90%.
links.quote: Clinicians using either collaborative workflow outperformed those using traditional tools, achieving average accuracies of 85% (AI-first) and 82% (AI-second), compared to 75% with traditional resources (p < 0.0004 and p < 0.00001; mean differences = 9.8% and 6.8%; 95% CI = 4.6%–15% and 4.0%–9.6%).

links.outcome: workflow accuracy compared with AI-alone accuracy
